name: Machpelah
overview: Machpelah is established in Scripture as the divinely ordained burial site for the patriarchs and matriarchs of Israel, including Sarah, Abraham, Isaac, Rebekah, Leah, and Jacob. Abraham’s purchase of the cave and field of Machpelah from Ephron the Hittite was a significant act of faith and foresight, securing a family burial place in the land of Canaan. This possession, confirmed before the children of Heth, not only reflects the fulfillment of God’s promises to Abraham but also symbolizes the continuity of God’s covenant through the generations buried there.
